customManagers.description: Track Docker images nested in a workflow ${{ }} expression. The built-in github-actions manager does extract service images, but getDep skips any value containing '$' with skipReason 'contains-variable', so a conditional service image needs this manager to stay updated.
Track the actionlint container tag used by the justfile lint recipe
Track the prettier version used by the justfile fmt and fmt-check recipes

packageRules.description: The shared preset turns off digest pinning for custom.regex docker deps, since those managers usually capture a version only. The workflow-expression manager captures currentDigest too, so pinning is re-enabled for it. Every custom.regex manager reports as `custom.regex`, so matchManagers cannot single one out; matchFileNames is the only selector, and it must name the files the expression manager actually reads. A broader `.github/workflows/**` glob also caught the inherited `# renovate:` comment manager (e.g. KUBESEC_IMAGE_VERSION in security-config.yml), whose matchStrings have no currentDigest group, producing `Digest is not updated` and a failed branch. Repo-level rules are merged after preset ones, so this wins.

Self-reference: this repo pins its own composite actions by date tag (e.g. `actions/project/action.yml` -> `actions/setup-dde@<DATE-TAG>`). `merge.yml` cuts a new `YYYY-MM-DD` tag on every push to main, so the preset's `minimumReleaseAge: 1 day` never matures here: by the time today's tag is a day old, tomorrow's already exists and the update restarts as pending. That leaves the inner pins permanently stale and drags the staleness into every consumer repo. Waiving the age gate and the schedule for the self-reference only lets those pins track the tag immediately. Consumers keep the preset's 1-day soak, which is the point there: a fresh tag should sit before it rolls out widely.
